description: This Dart file defines the UI for the home screen of a Flutter-based restaurant application. It includes the main HomeScreen widget with subcomponents for profile header, status card, quick action grid, weather recommendations, and bottom navigation bar. The file integrates localizations, state management via Provider, and navigation to other screens.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the application's home screen, displaying restaurant info, status, quick actions, and navigation.

classes.name: _ProfileHeader
classes.description: Displays the restaurant's profile name and story.

classes.name: _StatusCard
classes.description: Shows whether the restaurant is open or closed with operating hours.

classes.name: _QuickActions
classes.description: Grid of quick action tiles for navigating to menu, cart, order history, reviews, social feed, and contact.

classes.name: _ActionTile
classes.description: Individual touchable card for quick actions with icon and label.

classes.name: _BottomNav
classes.description: Bottom navigation bar allowing switching between main sections.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the home screen UI, including app bar, list view with profile, status, quick actions, and bottom navigation.
